content:
lina: Heads-up: launch week playbook draft. Primary experiment = gated vs instant credits + prompt-template exposure. We need clear measurement windows: 24h & 7d. Post cadence: teaser (Mon), demo clip (Wed), benchmark story (Thu) + live webinar Thu eve.

omar: Love the cadence. Variant assignment idea: cookie+Segment trait so we can track cross-device. A=instant 800 credits at signup, B=gated 300 on email confirm + 800 on first successful request. Control = no credit.

preeti: For the prompt-template exposure: show 3 curated templates in onboarding email for A, delay templates until first request for B. Metric: prompts_opened & prompts_used. Also add a tiny checklist in the email to nudge usage.

lina: Landing page -> register -> confirm email -> thank you page (with onboarding gif). We should append utm_variant param and include variant in the signup trait.

omar: Pseudocode we plan to push to Segment:

```
const variant = chooseVariant(user.id, ['control','A','B'])
analytics.identify(user.id, { launch_variant: variant })
if (variant === 'A') { post('/hooks/credit', {user_id, amount:800}) }
```

Add idempotency token and TTL to webhook payload.

infra-bot: Staging hooks deployed: `/hooks/launch-credit-v1`, `/hooks/promptpack-v1`, `/hooks/sdr-route`. Staging test ID: x-hook-198. Logs: https://ops.internal/tests/x-hook-198 :white_check_mark:

evan: Webinar flow: register -> immediate confirm email (variant B gets 300 on confirm) -> reminder 1hr + 15min -> live. Attendee bonus: 1200 credits + post-webinar promptpack. Non-attenders: 250 credits if they watch recording within 48h. Route leads with company_size >=50 OR mrr_est >= 5k to SDR via /hooks/sdr-route.

preeti: Can we include 3 caption variants for the benchmark clip? Short punchy hooks for X and a longer LI post. I'll draft. Also will assemble promptpack at /marketing/promptpacks/launch_v2 and include IDs in follow-up.

lina: Analytics events to emit: launch_signup, launch_confirm, launch_credit_granted, first_successful_request, promptpack_sent, webinar_attend. Tag event with variant and cohort. Need dashboards for 24h/7d and token-cost-per-activation.

omar: A/B measurement plan: primary metric = activated (first_successful_request) at 7d. Secondary: tokens used/day, prompts_used, retention at 14d. Use BigQuery event sinks.

infra-bot: Notes: webhooks are idempotent by request_id; will return 200 with existing credit_id if duplicate. Staging verification complete.

lina: Action items: preeti -> caption variants + promptpack upload; omar -> Segment variant assignment + webhook tests; evan -> finalize webinar reminders + SDR criteria; infra-bot -> provide final test log link. Follow-up check-in tomorrow 10:30am PT. :sparkles:
